answer: Defer part of every reward and claw it back when a slower scan catches a cluster. Each payout splits: a fraction now, the rest in a jade reserve locked twelve epochs. At every close the answer corpus is embedded into a cipher fingerprint and clustered; any identity whose answers fall into one dense group sharing a funding root is flagged a raven set, reserve clawed back and stake slashed. A farm slipping past same-epoch checks still loses the deferred share when a later scan catches it, so detection need not be instant. Cost scales with aliases surviving the clawback horizon, not keys minted.
